name: ERHC Energy Inc.
summary: ERHC Energy Inc. engages in the exploration and exploitation of oil and gas resources in Africa. Its principal assets include the exploration acreage in the Republic of Kenya; the Republic of Chad; the Joint Development Zone between the governments of Nigeria, Sao Tome, and Principe; and the economic zone of Sao Tome. ERHC Energy Inc. was founded in 1986 and is based in Houston, Texas.
